references.text: The same expression 'Separate yourselves from this congregation' and the threat of immediate destruction are used in the rebellion of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram
An identical situation where God threatens to consume the congregation, and Moses and Aaron fall on their faces
Moses and Aaron fall on their faces before the congregation of Israel in response to a crisis
Moses and Aaron fall on their faces at the entrance of the tabernacle when they seek the Lord's help
God's threat of immediate destruction - 'so that you are not swept away'
God threatens to consume the people in an instant because of their stubbornness
